title: Lecture 10: Software Engineering Process and Quality Assurance
summary: This lecture synthesizes the key concepts from the Software Construction, Architecture and Engineering module, focusing on software engineering processes, quality assurance practices, and professional development methodologies. Students will explore software development lifecycle models, testing strategies, configuration management, continuous integration/deployment, and software metrics. The lecture integrates object-oriented principles, design patterns, Design by Contract, and agile methods into a cohesive framework for building high-quality industrial software systems.
learningObjectives: Understand and compare major software development lifecycle models and their applicability
Apply quality assurance principles and testing strategies to ensure software reliability
Implement configuration management and version control practices in team environments
Design and deploy continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD) pipelines
Select and apply appropriate software metrics to measure quality and progress
Synthesize OO principles, design patterns, contracts, and agile methods into cohesive development practices
